name: TapiCoin

No presale, no VC allocation, no fake promises, just a tiny chaotic meme coin with real liquidity, real holders, real trades, and a mascot that looks far too happy for crypto. TAPI is experimental, community-driven, and created for fun, learning, and pure Solana meme energy. No investment promise, no guaranteed value, no ownership rights, and no revenue rights.
